subject: Short continuity memo & attestation request for SOC 2 post-report window
messages:
From: Lisa Conway <lisa.conway@auroradataworks.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@auroradataworks.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short continuity memo / attestation to cover post-report gap

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 Type II report packet you provided last quarter. Our legal and security teams are finishing Aurora's risk review and have one follow-up: we need a short continuity memo (brief attestation) that covers the period after your report end date (report end: 2027-12-31) through the current date.

Specifically we need a 1-page or short-form letter that:
- States the SOC 2 scope and confirms no material changes to the control environment since 2027-12-31 (or calls out any material changes)
- Identifies whether there were any incidents affecting control objectives in the period and, if so, a short summary and remediation status
- Notes any relevant subservice provider changes (if applicable)

Can you confirm if Redwood can provide this by 2028-03-19 EOD? Also please include a short evidence bundle (SOC 2 PDF, change log, KMS rotation summary) as attachments or links. If there are any costs or an approval step required to have this signed by a VP-level signee, let me know.

Thanks — we appreciate a concise note; our deadline for procurement sign-off is 2028-03-22.

Best,
Lisa Conway
Security Program Manager — Aurora Dataworks
Lisa.Conway@auroradataworks.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Conway <lisa.conway@auroradataworks.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short continuity memo / attestation to cover post-report gap

Thanks Lisa — we can do that.

Planned deliverables:
- Short-form continuity memo signed by our VP, Security (Monica Patel). Draft will be 1 page with clear scope and period.
- Evidence bundle: SOC 2 Type II PDF (report end 2027-12-31), control change log (csv), KMS rotation summary (xlsx), incident summary (if any).

Proposed timeline: draft to you by 2028-03-16 EOD for review, final signed memo and attachments by 2028-03-18. If you need the signature sooner we can prioritize but would ask for a same-day review turnaround.

Notes / assumptions:
- We will describe only material changes; routine configuration changes and patching will be summarized in the control_change_log file.
- Subservice provider changes will be called out if they affect the SOC 2 scope.

Attaching the SOC 2 file and an internal checklist now as placeholders — final evidence set will be shared via link or DocuSign bundle with the signed memo.

If that timeline works, I’ll kick off the approval and get a VP sign-off slot.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20271231.pdf, internal_chklst.pdf

Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short continuity memo / attestation to cover post-report gap

Priya — quick edit suggestions before we send the draft to Aurora:
- Add a single paragraph explicitly naming the report end date (2027-12-31) and the exact coverage window (through 2028-03-15) so their reviewers can't infer a different window.
- Call out subservice providers with only a single sentence: "No changes to critical subservice providers impacting the control scope since report end date," unless there were changes — in which case list them by name.
- For incident language prefer: "One low-severity operational incident (2028-01-28) was contained; controls functioned as intended and remediation was completed on 2028-02-03." Keep it factual and short.
- Make sure we include the control_change_log_2028Q1.csv and kms_rotation_summary_2028.xlsx in the evidence bundle.

FYI I uploaded the current draft and evidence to the Trust drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_evidence — please pull the latest before sending.

"Redwood Inference confirms that, between the SOC 2 report period end (2027-12-31) and 2028-03-15: (1) there were no material changes to the control environment that would materially affect the operating effectiveness of the controls described in the report; (2) there was one low-severity operational incident that was contained and remediated; (3) no changes to critical subservice providers impacted the scope of the report."
